sources.title: Avatar Mountains, How to Visit Zhangjiajie Avatar, China
sources.content:
The Avatar Mountains are located in Yuanjiajie, Wulingyuan Scenic Area of Hunan Province, China. These iconic formations inspired the floating mountains in the film Avatar, offering incredible photo opportunities.

Yuanjiajie is home to the famous Hallelujah Mountain (阿凡达哈利路亚山), which inspired the floating peaks in Avatar, as well as the dramatic No.1 Bridge Under Heaven (天下第一桥).

A 2-3 day trip to Zhangjiajie is sufficient to experience its highlights. Day 1: Yuanjiajie Scenic Area - Arrive before 9 am. Use the elevator up, hike between viewpoints, and descend later in the afternoon.

sources.title: A Complete Guide to Zhangjiajie: The Avatar Mountains
sources.content: A complete guide to Zhangjiajie and the Avatar Mountains. Yuanjiajie is the most famous section of the national forest park, home to the Hallelujah Mountain that inspired the floating mountains in James Cameron's Avatar. The Bailong Elevator provides quick access to the top. Key viewpoints include the No.1 Bridge Under Heaven, Misty Platform (Mihun Tai), and the Back Garden.

sources.title: Avatar Mountains Travel Guide 2026: Hallelujah Mountain & Essential Tips
sources.content: Avatar Mountains Travel Guide 2026 covering Hallelujah Mountain and essential tips. Yuanjiajie features towering sandstone peaks accessible via the Bailong Elevator. The area includes several iconic viewpoints and natural bridges. Year-round destination with spring (March-May) and autumn (September-November) being most picturesque.

sources.title: What to do in Zhangjiajie: 2026 Guide to the Avatar Mountains
sources.content: 2026 Guide to the Avatar Mountains in Zhangjiajie. Yuanjiajie is the highlight of any Zhangjiajie visit. The Bailong Elevator ascends 326 meters in under 2 minutes. Key sights include the Hallelujah Mountain, No.1 Bridge Under Heaven, and the Enchanting Platform. Best visited on clear days for optimal views of the floating pillars.

sources.title: Yuanjiajie Scenic Area (2026) - Tripadvisor
sources.content: Yuanjiajie Scenic Area visitor reviews. The Avatar Mountains are absolutely breathtaking. The Bailong Elevator is a must for the quickest access. The No.1 Bridge Under Heaven is spectacular. Arrive early to beat the crowds. Allow 2-3 hours to explore all the viewpoints. Can be combined with Tianzi Mountain in one day.

sources.title: 袁家界_百度百科
sources.content:
袁家界位于湖南省张家界市武陵源风景名胜区北部，是张家界国家森林公园的核心景区。面积约1200公顷，平均海拔1074米，以石英砂岩峰林地貌著称。

东接金鞭溪，西连天子山，森林覆盖率达98%。景区地处杉刀沟北麓，被誉为天然氧吧。

主要景点：
天下第一桥：跨度20余米、垂直落差357米的天然石桥，是张家界十大绝景之一
哈利路亚悬浮山：原名乾坤柱，是《阿凡达》悬浮山的原型
迷魂台：观景台可万千景象尽收眼底
沙刀沟：峡谷中有小溪，传说与古代袁姓将士隐居有关
后花园、双龟登天、绝壁仙官等特色景观

百龙天梯：2002年4月竣工，垂直高差335米，被载入吉尼斯世界纪录。

年平均气温16.8°C，四季皆可游览。名称源于后唐时期，黄巢手下有一名将士姓袁，为躲避追捕而隐居于此。

2025年11月匈牙利代表团访问袁家界，双方商定文旅合作项目。

sources.title: 张家界袁家界景区游玩攻略 - 携程攻略
sources.content: 张家界袁家界景区游玩攻略。袁家界是张家界最著名的景区之一，拥有天下第一桥、哈利路亚山（乾坤柱）、迷魂台等标志性景点。可乘坐百龙天梯快速上山，建议游览时间2-3小时。与天子山景区可在同一天游览。
